summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The ActivePassive U.S. Equity ETF (APUE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund blends an active and passive management approach to build its portfolio. The fund aims to optimize costs, tracking and potentially produce higher returns by shifting exposure between active and passive investments in the broad US equity market APUE was launched on May 3, 2023 and is issued by Envestnet.

holdings.infoBox: APUE is an equity ETF with a total of 453 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.13%, Apple at 6.81%, Microsoft at 5.10%, Alphabet at 5.02%, and Dimensional U.S. Small Cap ETF at 4.39%.
